To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

IL-6 is induced in SC following gamma-irradiation at all ages studied, that IL-6 upregulation results from transcriptional activation and that both IL-1 and -6 have a radi-protective effect at testicular and germ cells levels.
the response of Sertol cells to gamma radiation involves the production of the cytokine IL-6 and this production is a function of their differentiation.
IL-6 is a key cytokine for in vitro and in in vivo response of SC to gamma irradiation and has a radioprotection role on germ cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of markers of radiation exposure and the study of the mechanisms involved in radiation response of SC.
the role of SC in response to irradiation and the radioprotective action of SC cytokines on germ cells.
the identification of a new marker for radiation exposure and with the identification of new strategies for radioprotection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IL-6 seems a good marker of gamma radiation exposure and that IL-6 is a good candidate for the development of new radioprotectors.
the response of Sertolicells to gamma irradiation is characterized by the induction of IL-6 and that the injection of IL-6 prior to irradiation protects DNA of germ cells.
the IL-6 response to irradiation in SC seems to be an age-dependent response, which is not dose dependent, and is due to transcriptional activation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IL-6 is a good marker of radiation exposure and a good candidate for radioprotection.
SC are able to sense the radiation dose and to respond to it through IL-6.
the IL-6 cytokine is a key cytokine for the response of SC to external gamma irradiations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IL-1/IL-6 are good candidates for the protection of germ cells against gamma irradiation.
the induction of IL-6 by irradiation of SC is a function of cell differentiation and is mediated by a transcriptional activation.
the response to irradiation is a function of SC maturation and that the induction of IL-6 is not only due to the irradiation itself but also to the differentiation status of SC.
